note: City of Paola campground on the west shore of 200-acre Lake Miola, in a 560-acre park with a beach, boat ramp, playground, dog park and trails. RVs use the lower campground, a shaded area of angled pads on the shore (some pull-through, some full hookup, many not level); the upper campground is tents only. Camp host in summer; permits at the caretaker's office near the boat ramp. Push-button showers. Zebra mussels in the lake: clean and dry boats. --Claude
